title.narrative: Solomon Islands Threshold-Threshold Fund

description.narrative: The Solomon Islands: The MCC Threshold Program with the Government of Solomon Islands aims to reduce poverty by assisting the government in addressing the country's biggest constraints to economic growth: ineffective management of natural resources in the forestry sector and lack of secure access to land which limits tourism investment. The Threshold Program will address these challenges through two projects: the Forest Value Enhancement Project (FoVEP) and the Accessing Land for Tourism Investment Facilitation (ALTIF) Project.

condition.narrative: The Solomon Islands Threshold has no valid policy, performance, or fiduciary conditions associated with it or any of its activities as the funding for the program is entirely managed by the Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC). Throughout the course of the four-year program, MCC will manage and disburse the Grant in accordance with the terms of the agreement. The Program Agreement provides additional information on the reason for this funding arrangement and relevant terms of the grant.
